additionalInfo.label: Optional display settings
additionalInfo.helperText: Add your own privacy description and policy information.

optional.label: Consent optional
optional.description: Viewer can use site without selecting a privacy consent; tracking starts immediately until rejected by viewer.

required.label: Require consent
required.description: Viewer must accept or reject tracking to use site; tracking does not start unless accepted by viewer.

consentText.label: Privacy description
consentText.helperText: Displayed in privacy notice to site viewer.

policyURL.label: Policy link
policyURL.helperText: Displayed as a "More information" link in privacy notice.
policyURL.error: Must be a valid URL to be displayed.
